completeness.why: All five provider link functions now only do their own bank lookup and call linkBankSyncAccount, which owns upgrade-or-insert (with the missing-account throw), the transfer payee, the initial syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and the sync-event; the preserved differences (GoCardless mask/official_name, Pluggy fileId, Akahu's tables) are passed as explicit arguments, and EnableBanking's unreachable id check is simply dropped.

interface.why: Parameters cover the real variations (accountFields for the per-provider insert keys, optional fileId, syncTables) with no speculative options; minor roughness: bank.id and bank.bank_id are passed as two separate ids instead of the bank row, accountSyncSource is an untyped string, and 'offBudget ? 1 : 0' is still computed at each site.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies of the link sequence are removed in favour of linkBankSyncAccount in server/accounts/app.ts; no reshaped copy remains.
